description: This file defines a service for managing an 'acpx-runtime' in a plugin system, including creation, startup, health checks, and shutdown procedures. It handles runtime configuration, registration, health probing, and logging.

classes.name: AcpxRuntimeLike
classes.description: An interface extending AcpRuntime with additional health check methods.

methods.name: createAcpxRuntimeService
methods.description: Creates and returns a plugin service object that manages the lifecycle of an acpx runtime, including start and stop procedures, health checks, and registration.
